title: Numerical ramification and relative invariants of normed valued fields
statement: Let K and L be fields [def-weil-field] with nonarchimedean real multiplicative norms. Their rings of integers are the valuation subrings [def-trf-valuation-ring] O_K={x:|x|≤1}, their residue fields are O_K/m_K where m_K={x:|x|<1}, and their value groups Γ_K are the images of K^× in the positive reals. A norm-preserving field embedding induces its restricted local integer-ring homomorphism and the canonical map on residue fields, sending the class of x to the class of its image. For a compatible field extension, put e(L/K)=[Γ_L:Γ_K], f(L/K)=[res(L):res(K)] and d(L/K)=[L:K]/(ef), with d rational-valued and e,f natural-valued (zero for infinite index or degree). The residue scalar action is induced by the canonical map. Immediate means Γ_K=Γ_L and surjectivity of the residue map. Residue separability uses the separable algebraic extension notion [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Unramified means e=d=1 with separable residue extension. Tame means d=1 with separable residue extension and e coprime to the positive residue characteristic, with no index restriction in characteristic zero. Set E(L/K)=rrk(Γ_L/Γ_K) using cardinal rational rank [def-trf-rational-rank], and F(L/K)=trdeg_res(K) res(L), the cardinal transcendence degree [def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Outside compatible pairs the value-group quotient is by Γ_K∩Γ_L.
